arts.ttl: Eintracht Frankfurt beaten by Atalanta as Jonathan Burkardt injured
arts.sum: Despite starting well, Eintracht Frankfurt came unravelled in the second half as Jonathan Burkardt left the pitch injured and Atalanta scored three goals in the space of six minutes. Frankfurt: Zetterer - Collins, Koch (c), Theate, Brown – Dahoud (Skhiri 69’), Chaïbi – Dōan (Buta 78’), Götze (Batshuayi 69’), Knauff (Wahi 78’) – Burkardt (Bahoya 59’) Unused subs: Grahl, Santos, Amenda, Højlund, Kristensen, Chandler, Dills Out: Uzun (hamstring), Larsson (muscle) Coach: Dino Toppmöller

arts.ttl: Eintracht Frankfurt vs. Atalanta: UEFA Champions League LIVE blog and team news
arts.sum: Having rediscovered their form in the Bundesliga, Eintracht Frankfurt will look to get their UEFA Champions League campaign back on track when they welcome Atalanta to Deutsche Bank Park on Wednesday (kick-off: 9pm CET). Dino Toppmöller ’s side have yet to return to winning ways in Europe, however, having lost to Atlético Madrid and Liverpool and drawn with Napoli since a thumping 5-1 victory over Galatasaray in their opening game.
